title: 建築構法計画
subtitle: Building System Design
keywords: Structural systems 2.Building elements 3.Design of building elements 4.Building element performance 5.Building production system
educationalGoal: In this course, students develop the knowledge required for planning, constructing, and maintaining buildings while comprehensively considering building materials, structural systems, and equipment. Specifically, they acquire the basic knowledge of building systems to standardize or componentize buildings, and learn new about designs in the environmental age.
advice: This course explains the typical of structural systems and building elements from the viewpoints of required performance and construction work, and shows examples of superior building element design. In the first half of this course, structural systems are explained, outlining all the materials used and the points that need supervision in each type of construction work. In the latter half, finishing layers and substrates are explained with respect to each building element. The contents of this course are as follows. 1. Structural systems: steel construction, reinforced concrete construction, and wooden construction. 2. Building elements: roofs, walls, openings, floors, stairs, and ceilings. 3. Building system design methods: prefabrication, modular coordination, and componentization.
requiredKnowledge: Students don't need any special background, because this course is a first step in learning building production. Students are urged to deepen their understanding of structural systems and building elements by observing many buildings in their daily lives.

activityGoals.body: Students can explain the basics of building materials and building systems.
Students can explain the constituent elements and required performance of basic structural systems that support.
Students can explain the constituent elements and required performance of basic building elements that partition
Students can explain the merits of prefabrication, componentization, and industrialization of buildings.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students can explain the basics of building materials and building systems, showing typical specifications. Based on their understanding of the constituent elements and required performance of basic structural systems as well as basic building elements, students can explain the important points that need supervision in construction work and in building maintenance. Based on their understanding of the merits of prefabrication, componentization, and industrialization of buildings, students are can explain important points for planning such structures.
achievementLevels.standard: Students can explain the basics of building materials and building systems. Based on their understanding of the constituent elements and required performance of basic structural systems as well as basic building elements, students can explain the important points that need supervision in construction works. Students can explain the merits of prefabrication, componentization, and industrialization of buildings.

lessons.content: Guidance Students learn scenarios for considering the flow of power in structural systems, and learn the vocabulary of building elements.
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Structural systems (1): materials for steel structures Students learn the types, standards, and jointing of steel members.
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Structural systems (2): design of steel structures Students learn the important points of designing and supervising steel constructions via examples of frame construction and trusses
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Structural systems (3): materials for reinforced concrete structures Students learn the standard materials of reinforced concrete structures as well as how the materials use each other's advantages. ●Small test and review covering from the first lecture to the third
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Structure systems (4) design of reinforced concrete structure Students learn the important points of designing and supervising reinforced concrete constructions throughout instances of the frame construction and the wall construction.
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Structure systems (5) materials for wooden structure Students learn the type, standard and jointing of wooden members.
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Structure systems (6) design of wooden structure Students learn the important points of designing and supervising wooden constructions throughout instances of the Japanese conventional construction and the so-called 2x4 construction. ●Small test and review covering from the fourth lecture to the seventh
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Structure systems (6) ground leveling and foundations Students learn not only the type of piles and foundations but also the important points of supervising the construction of those.
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Building elements (1) roofs Students learn not only the waterproofing of pitched roofs and flat roofs but also the superior roof designs.
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Building elements (2) walls #1 Students learn not only the layers of walls installed into detached houses but also the superior wall designs of those. ●Small test and review covering from the eighth lecture to the ninth
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Building elements (3) walls #2 Students learn not only the layers of walls installed into office buildings but also the superior wall designs of those.
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Building elements (4) openings Students learn not only the way of opening and shutting of windows and doors but also the superior designs of the openings.
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Building elements (5) floors and stairs Students learn the layers of floors, the details of stairs, and the superior designs of stairs. ●Small test and review covering from the tenth lecture to the twelfth
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Building elements (5) ceilings Students learn not only the structure of ceilings but also the superior designs of ceilings.
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.

lessons.content: Methods of building system design Students learn the merits of prefabrication and modular coordination of buildings. ●Small test and review covering from the thirteenth lecture to the fifteenth
lessons.assignments: Review lecture notes to develop understanding.
